instruction: Implement windows.count(events, now, window). events is a list of [id_string, integer_timestamp, label_string]; now and window are integers. Deduplicate by id using its final occurrence in input order before filtering. Count each surviving event by label iff now-window < timestamp <= now; exclude future events. Input timestamps need not be ordered. Return a dictionary with positive counts only. window <= 0 raises ValueError. Do not mutate events. All input shapes and types are valid.
